svg.aria-label: Wiring diagram linking the AR0544 image sensor, the AR0544 Demo3 camera headboard and the Demo3 baseboard
svg.text: AR0544 ↔ Camera Headboard ↔ Demo3 Baseboard — Interconnect Diagram
Camera: AR0544CSSC11SMKAH3-GEVB (5 MP RGB, 11° CRA) • Baseboard: AGB1N0CS-GEVK (Demo3) • Sensor: AR0544 ODCSP47 (47-ball CSP)
CAMERA MODULE (Demo3 headboard + lens + tripod block)
P24 debug tap · P27 EEPROM address
TP8 S_CLK · TP9 FB_CLK · TP10 M_CLK
all clock nets swing at 1.8 V
soft reset over I²C after release
MR asserted → RESET low for 240 ms
P6 1×3 GPIO2 pull hi / lo open
jumpered = strap to a fixed level.
GND C5 C6 E6 (dig) · E4 E8 (acore)
source: 5 V from the USB 3.0 bus
1 Gb frame buffer ≈ 3 frames of a 20 MP sensor
FPGA configuration image, written via FX3 SPI
do NOT use a USB 2 port
bus 5 V powers the whole stack
• AR0544 balls → headboard muxes / buffers / regulators → J1 (52-pin QFS) ⬌ P5 on Demo3 → FPGA → FX3 → USB 3.0 → host PC running DevWare.
• Only MIPI lanes 0–1 plus the clock lane are populated. The AR0544 is a 2-lane D-PHY part, so J1 pins 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 (DATA2, DATA3) stay unused.
• Demo3 pin 5 is documented as S_RESERVED1 in EVBUM2310/D but is used as the frame-buffer clock (DEMO_FB_CLK) by the headboard — check both documents before reusing it.
Bandwidth ceiling — check this before expecting 60 fps
• Sensor capability: 2 lanes × 1.72 Gbps = 3.44 Gbps. Demo3 MIPI receiver: 2 lanes × 0.768 Gbps = 1.54 Gbps. The baseboard, not the sensor, is the bottleneck.
• 5 MP × 10 bit × 60 fps ≈ 3.0 Gbps of pixel payload alone, i.e. about 1.5 Gbps per lane — roughly twice what this baseboard can receive. Blanking overhead makes it worse.
• Workable Demo3 configurations: ~30 fps at full resolution, DPCM 10→8 compression, a crop such as 1080p, or a skipped / binned / summed mode.
• EVBUM2310/D Table 1 lists HEAD_RESET_L with direction “Out”; the headboard manuals list the same pin as an input. The headboard view is the self-consistent one.
• The AR0544 ball names carry both D-PHY and C-PHY aliases (ZP0_A0, ZN0_B0, CP_C0 …). The public data sheet specifies 2-lane D-PHY only; treat C-PHY as unconfirmed.

Drawn from public onsemi documents: AR0544-PD/D rev. 12, EVBUM2310/D (Demo3), EVBUM2904/D (a comparable D-PHY headboard), and the AR0544_CSP47_Demo3Head schematic rev 1.0. Register-level and timing detail lives in the full AR0544 data sheet, which is released under NDA — verify there before committing a design.
